_comment: Streamable HTTP remote MCP connector registration metadata for Perplexity. Fill in deployment_url before registering.
notes: All three tools accept no arguments. Send params: {} or omit params.
Do not add new tools to this surface without updating permitted_tools here and adding a test in perplexity.test.js.
This connector does NOT expose Crucible learning/research retrieval to Perplexity search.
AI Collaboration routing is config-gated via AI_COLLABORATION_BASE_URL.
